audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart said Akshan wins levels 1-3 then Skill from 4-5 onward, contradicting its own whys, the packet chart and the 55.17% win rate.
audit.why: whys[0] describes level 1 as a coin flip (both champs have one shot and one Q), whys[3]-[5] describe levels 4-5, 6 and first item as Akshan windows. The packet chart reads Skill, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Akshan, Skill.
audit.corrected: Level 1 -> Skill; Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item -> Akshan; 2+ items stays Skill. Ratings re-tuned to match; whys rewritten for the flipped rows.

audit.why: Spikes are level 2-3 (second Dirty Fighting shot + Avengerang out-and-back), level 6 Comeuppance (2500 range, 100/85/70s), first-item lethality with the Heroic Swing takedown reset, and Karma late scaling. Content spikes[] already carries all four accurately.
audit.corrected: Left the four content spikes intact; level-chart ratings now reflect the same spikes (L6 7/10, first item 7/10, 2+ items 5/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Karma "he/his", referred to her W as "Focused Resolve (Tether)", and repeatedly claimed she has an "interrupt" that cancels Heroic Swing. Karma has no interrupt, knockup or displacement in her kit.
audit.why: Riot text: Focused Resolve (W) is a 675-range tether, flat 12s at all ranks, roots only if the tether is NOT broken, reveals the target, and Mantra-W heals her and extends the root. Mantra (R) needs no skill point and is live from level 1 on 40/38/36/34s, and Gathering Fire (P) refunds it on every damaging spell. Nothing in her kit interrupts a channel or a dash.
audit.corrected: Real names used, the tether-break-by-distance and 675-range interaction stated, Mantra-from-level-1 plus the Gathering Fire refund stated, and the false interrupt claim replaced with the actual punish (landing next to a charged Mantra).

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block named no numbers.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank and Mantra is 40s at rank 1 but shrinks with Gathering Fire, so the punishable window is countable off her Q casts.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries the 12s / 675 range and the 40s Mantra with its Gathering Fire refund.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds note despite Karma healing off Mantra-W.
audit.why: _missing/akshan.json flags needs-antiheal for this matchup; Mantra-W heals Karma and extends the root, which is her only sustain in lane.
audit.corrected: whys[3] now names Mantra-W self-heal as her only sustain and Executioner’s as the answer in long trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said about her W revealing you.
audit.why: Riot text for Focused Resolve says it damages and reveals the target, so Going Rogue camouflage will not shake a tether that is already on you.
audit.corrected: Added the reveal to the Key Ability Interactions line.

notes: Level-chart flip is proposed as one atomic group (content win[0],[3],[4],[5] plus full phases[0],[3],[4],[5].side and the five ratings) — apply together or not at all. Full-layer text used male pronouns for Karma throughout and invented an 'interrupt' she does not have; both fixed. Kit-derived 'terrain' flag on Akshan W (Going Rogue) misfires — Going Rogue is camouflage that decays away from terrain, it does not create terrain; no page text asserted otherwise. Whether a root cancels Heroic Swing mid-arc is not in Riot's text, so no claim was made either way. No karma__akshan.json mirror exists in audits/top, so nothing to reconcile against.
